text:
Ana: Quick heads-up — planning a 3-day micro-surge next week to "sculpt" the post-launch backlog. Goal: reduce P0/P1 churn and ship 1–2 tiny delight items. Need quick alignment on scope + acceptance gates.

Devin: +1. Can you share the candidate list? want to avoid rework. :eyes: 

Mira: I'll pull the bug heatmap and top customer-reported issues. Proposal: hard stop on any new features during micro-surge except those marked `customer-blocker` or `quick-delight` (<2 dev days).

Jamal: We have one recurring embed regression hitting a small but high-value cohort — it's noisy in telemetry but not widespread. Is that P0 or P1 for this wave?

Mira: If it causes customer-facing failures or data loss -> P0. Otherwise we treat as P1 unless the cohort is >5% of requests. TL;DR: crash/data-loss = P0, regressions with clear repro in prod -> P1.

Kevin: From infra side: we can dedicate one squad for rollback/canary support. Suggest we require a canary toggle and a rollback playbook for any change touching serving runtime. No changes without a canary plan.

triage-bot: backlog-summary: total open issues = 137, P0=2, P1=12, candidate quick-delights=7. Top P1s by signal: embed-regression, prompt-truncation, cost-metric drift. Link: https://redwood.internal/backlog/1769999997

Devin: Thanks. My suggested micro-surge scope (shortlist):
- Fix embed-regression (P1)
- Prompt truncation guardrails (P1)
- Remove stale feature-flag for legacy routing (quick-delight, <1d)
- Triage & close low-signal bugs older than 90d (housekeeping)

Mira: Suggestion: enforce acceptance tests for each item. Requirements: reproducible repro steps, perf check (p95 latency no worse), and smoke test on canary. Example acceptance checklist: 
```
- repro steps included
- unit + integration tests updated
- canary run for 2h with no regressions
- run regression eval on small prompt set (pass rate >= 95%)
```

Jamal: Heads-up on capacity: ops + infra can support the canary windows but need schedule by EOD today. Also call out that customer support will be on hotline during surge.

Ana: Decision draft: Prioritize P0s (both), top 5 P1s by customer impact (we pick embed-regression and prompt truncation), ship legacy flag removal as quick-delight, and carve out a housekeeping slot for bulk triage. Any objections?

Kevin: No objections. I'll add canary templates and rollback runbook to the PR checklist.

Devin: I'll own the grooming list and PRs for the quick-delight. ETA: first pass by tomorrow 11am PT.

Mira: I'll produce the heatmap + repro links and mark the top 5 P1s. Will tag customer contacts for the embed regression.

Ana: Action items recap: @Devin create shortlist PR + assign reviewers; @Mira heatmap + repro links; @Kevin add canary/rollback templates; @Jamal coordinate ops windows + hotline. We'll run a 30m kickoff tomorrow 11:30 to lock schedules.

Devin: ack, adding items to the grooming doc now.

triage-bot: note: created ticket micro-surge-1769999997 with checklist and calendar invites.

Ana: Great. One last ask — keep scope surgical. If a fix balloons beyond 2 dev days, table it for follow-on milestone 'micro-delight-2' unless it's P0. :scalpel:

Mira: Understood. I'll flag anything that grows.

Jamal: 👍 prepping ops playbook.

Ana: Closing thread — will post kickoff invite and the grooming doc link in #product. Thanks everyone. :tada:
